Cristian Rodríguez (XDS Astana) is the local rider of the day as he hails from El Ejido, near Almeria, around 100 kilometres from today’s course.
The main local cycling event is the Clasica de Almeria, held since 1986 and won by Biniam Girmay last February. Magnus Cort won it in 2017.
The women’s event has been held since 2023. The first edition finished in Vera - Canada’s Emilie Fortin won ahead of her compatriot Alison Jackson."],"year":2026,"stage":12,"stageType":"HMG","picto":"liv_story","highlight":false,"createdAt":"2026-09-03T12:37:34+02:00","publicationAt":"2026-09-03T12:37:34+02:00","id":61519,"slug":"welcome-to-almeria","pinned":false,"createdBy":"bvittek","_id":"56216664714663c97ed1413ee6e764f995422c8358ff048673f304feac2c637b","_bind":"publication_en-2026-12","_origin":"news-2026-12","_updatedAt":1788431854804,"_parent":"stage-2026:2b04ffe490dd4bf9e3918b4334bc27f01bcc349c9637fb83ce90e60917ed5b5d","_key":"_id","_virtual":"news:welcome-to-almeria","model":"news"},{"name":"La Vuelta 2026 -
